laws.rule: Jotunheimen National Park (in Lom, Vågå and Vang in Innlandet; Luster and Årdal in Vestland) bans motor-powered model aircraft and model boats, and unnecessary noise (section 3, point 7.3). The text says 'and the like'; it does not name drones, so whether drones are covered is not settled by the wording. Park exemptions come from the park authority.

Motor traffic on land and water is banned in the park, including taking off and landing aircraft and flying below 300 m above ground (section 3, point 6.1), with exceptions for emergencies, management and some listed uses. Parking caravans and motorhomes is banned as a landscape intrusion (point 1.1). Careful use of wood for a fire is allowed (point 2.2 b); vegetation including dead wood is otherwise protected (point 2.1). The regulation does not address tents.
